simple.meaning: נִרְגָּן (nirgân) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a slanderer.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in Proverbs, beginning at Proverbs 16:28. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִרְגָּן (H5372) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נִרְגָּן (nirgân) / H5372 is traced through Proverbs 16:28, Proverbs 18:8, Proverbs 26:20, Proverbs 26:22 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to roll to pieces;

occurrences.englishText: A perverse man stirs up strife.
The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels:
For lack of wood a fire goes out.
The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels,
